name: C
description: C is the foundational systems programming language that powers operating systems, embedded devices, databases, and virtually every major software infrastructure. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Beej's Guide to C Programming
items.description: One of the most praised free guides — walks through basic syntax to memory management, pointers, and structs with clear modern examples.

items.title: Modern C (Jens Gustedt)
items.description: Teaches C as written today — incorporating C11/C17/C23 modern standards rather than outdated 1980s styles. Free PDF.

items.title: cppreference C Documentation
items.description: The best technical reference for C language and standard library, documenting features across C89, C99, C11, C17, and C23.

items.title: C23 Working Draft (N3220)
items.description: The official WG14 working draft representing the C23 standard with new features like nullptr and #embed.

items.title: Learn-C.org
items.description: Free interactive tutorial covering everything from basic loops to advanced pointers and binary trees — no compiler needed.

items.title: C Programming Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Massively popular multi-hour beginner-friendly walkthrough covering all core C concepts step-by-step.

items.title: C Programming & OOP (Dr. Chuck)
items.description: Deep-dive covering computer architecture, low-level mechanics, and classic K&R C teachings.

items.title: Exercism — C Track
items.description: 84 free coding exercises with 100% free human mentoring from volunteer experts.

items.title: Codewars — C Collection
items.description: Gamified community-filtered kata for C problem-solving and bit manipulation.

items.title: Cppreference C Reference
items.description: The definitive up-to-date language and standard library reference for all C versions.

items.title: ISO C Standards Updates
items.description: Community hub tracking all C standard iterations with latest working drafts.

items.title: Reddit r/C_Programming
items.description: Premier community for C news, discussions, and modern C development topics.

items.title: Reddit r/C_Programming
items.description: Active community for debugging help, tutorials, and modern C development discussions.

items.title: Stack Overflow — C Tag
items.description: Definitive Q&A for C troubleshooting, pointer issues, and low-level debugging.

lessons.title: Getting Started with C
lessons.description: Set up a C toolchain with gcc, understand compile/run, main function, and standard streams.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.description: Integral and floating types, fixed-width types, sizeof, and enumeration.

lessons.title: Operators and Expressions
lessons.description: Arithmetic, comparison, logical, bitwise operators, and precedence.

lessons.title: Control Flow
lessons.description: if/else, switch, for, while, do-while loops, and jump statements.

lessons.title: Functions and Prototypes
lessons.description: Function declarations, pass-by-value, pass-by-pointer, and recursion.

lessons.title: Arrays and Strings
lessons.description: One and multi-dimensional arrays, null-terminated strings, string.h.

lessons.title: Pointers
lessons.description: Address-of, dereference, pointer arithmetic, pointer-to-pointer, void*.

lessons.title: Structs and Unions
lessons.description: Struct declaration, member access, arrow operator, copies, unions.

lessons.title: Dynamic Memory
lessons.description: malloc, calloc, realloc, free, memory leaks, and heap patterns.

lessons.title: Preprocessor and Macros
lessons.description: #define, function-like macros, include guards, conditional compilation.

lessons.title: File I/O
lessons.description: fopen, fprintf/fscanf, fgets, binary I/O, fseek, and error handling.

lessons.title: Standard Library
lessons.description: string.h, stdlib.h, math.h, and ctype.h essentials.

lessons.title: Bit Manipulation
lessons.description: Bitwise operators, bit flags, bit tricks, and bitfields.

lessons.title: Function Pointers and Callbacks
lessons.description: Function pointer syntax, callbacks, qsort comparators, dispatch tables.

lessons.title: Linked Lists and Data Structures
lessons.description: Struct nodes, linked lists, traversal, free, and reusable patterns.

lessons.title: Recursion
lessons.description: Recursive functions, factorial, fibonacci, divide-and-conquer.

lessons.title: Error Handling
lessons.description: errno, perror, strerror, return codes, and setjmp/longjmp.

lessons.title: Multi-file Projects and Headers
lessons.description: Header files, include guards, separate compilation, static linkage.

lessons.title: Make and Build Tooling
lessons.description: Makefiles, targets, automatic variables, compiler flags, sanitizers.

lessons.title: Undefined Behavior and Debugging
lessons.description: OOB access, signed overflow, use-after-free, volatile, restrict, sanitizers.

lessons.title: Advanced: Variadics, Threads, and Atomics
lessons.description: Variadic functions, inline, C11 threads, atomics, low-level control.
